page: Microsoft Azure DC128eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEDV6 family. It is powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, offering 128 dedicated virtual CPUs. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes 7559 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC128eds_v6 offers a high density of dedicated compute cores and substantial local storage capacity, making it suitable for enterprise-scale workloads. The combination of 128 dedicated vCPUs, 512.0 GB of memory, and large local storage makes this instance appropriate for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and data warehousing.
